summary: Reconcile the inherited L4 follow-up with its existing upstream owner, TauCetiRoadmap PR #854. Import the authoritative Layer 4 contracts and account for all 221 inherited node IDs without parallel mathematical declarations. Distinguish exact mappings, supplier imports, replaced proof routes and three stronger inherited generalities not established by their import locators. Solid functional analysis remains excluded under the issue boundary. Completion concerns this ownership pass, without an implementation or upstream mathematical-review claim.

upstreamImports.locator: Layer 4, §§4.1–4.17; supporting tensor and analytic-stage contracts in Layer 0
upstreamImports.authority: PROTOCOL §15 includes open upstream roadmap pull requests. The maintainer identified this roadmap as already upstream in the comment on issue #9294 dated 2026-10-13.

obligations.need: Entire spectral resultants, quantitative convergence, Coleman transport, finite-module topology and finite-rank determinants with nilpotents retained.
obligations.boundary: Use every-radius Gauss convergence and the zero constant coefficient on the functional input where required. Finite determinant size is supplied rank, even when polynomial degree drops. General entire and compact-operator constructions retain their named suppliers. The coordinate-detection import is the Banach c0 case. Polynomial invertibility is imported only when the constant coefficient is a unit; finite transform multiplication is used under the upstream Banach-ring contract.
obligations.sourceLineage: As located by the upstream README: Coleman, Appendix A3, pp. 432–436, Lemma A3.8 and Theorem A3.9, pp. 435–436.

obligations.need: Completed scalar tensors, analytic base change, the image of dual scalar extension and constructed specialization.
obligations.boundary: Analytic stages use a c0 model; the dual has bounded coefficient families and need not be c0. The canonical dual scalar-extension map is not assumed surjective. Bounded coefficient maps carry norm constants, and ring-general dual specialization needs explicit coefficient bounds. A distribution stage used in Fredholm theory needs its own (Pr) justification.
obligations.sourceLineage: As located by the upstream README: Urban, §3.4, Lemmas 3.4.6–3.4.7, pp. 43–44; the completed-tensor supplier contracts in §0.0.

obligations.need: Universal-character semigroup charts, multipliers, common radii and destination-tail estimates.
obligations.boundary: The character exponential has a strict convergence condition, also at p=2. Operators are constructed from chart maps and cocycles before compactness is deduced from the destination estimates. Arithmetic semigroup data and roots remain supplier inputs.
obligations.sourceLineage: As located by the upstream README: Urban, Lemmas 3.4.6–3.4.7 and Corollary 3.4.10, pp. 43–45; BCGP II §1.8.5 and (1.8.6), p. 9, and §§4.6.46–4.6.48, pp. 93–95.

obligations.need: Compact homotopy endomorphisms of Banach complexes, numerical slope fibres, functorial finite perfect windows and derived base change.
obligations.boundary: Compactness of a homotopy class is witnessed by a degreewise compact representative. Its nonalternating characteristic product depends on that representative. Homotopy invariance concerns the selected finite-slope complex. Derived tensor comparison does not imply underived cohomology base change without the stated flatness hypotheses. Geometric numerical slope fibres have rank one.
obligations.sourceLineage: As located by the upstream README: Pilloni, §13.1, pp. 84–85; BCGP I §6.1.1, p. 139, and Theorem 6.3.16, pp. 152–153; Urban, Lemma 2.3.13, pp. 27–28.

obligations.need: Exact rational-slope rank and finite-slope Euler characteristic over general affinoids.
obligations.boundary: The geometric points are rank one and the exact cutoff is rational. The conclusions concern module rank and the alternating rank of a finite perfect complex. They do not imply that each cohomology dimension is locally constant.
obligations.sourceLineage: As located by the upstream README: Coleman, Appendix A5, Proposition A5.5 and Corollary A5.5.1, pp. 441–442, together with the explicit local Fredholm-window targets of §4.16.

obligations.need: Frechet and Stein comparison for the compact-operator finite-window construction.
obligations.boundary: Use the current AdicSpacesPartIII §R3.4 supplier, replacing the older PartII R3 pointer. The transition factorization and compactness in the actual coefficient norms are extra hypotheses. Closure-proper and Kiehl criteria require the stated comparison. Solid localization and reconstruction are outside this job.
obligations.sourceLineage: As located by the upstream README: Urban, §2.3.12 and Lemma 2.3.13, pp. 27–28; BCGP II Definition 2.2.17, p. 21, and §§4.6.46–4.6.49, pp. 93–95.

inheritedNodeDisposition.detail: The required contract includes a bound for the inverse of finite coordinate restriction, as well as injectivity. This target supplies both for a finite submodule of c0 over the stated Noetherian Banach algebra; the injectivity-only target at line 1437 is insufficient for the norm-bound assertion.

The inherited statement uses a potentially orthonormalizable module, so the c0-only target at line 1581 is read through chart/norm independence and the (Pr) zero-extension target at line 1589. This imports the identity evaluated at 1, without a commutation assumption; it does not assert multiplicativity of the entire series.

The formal coefficient recurrence and two-sided identity are at §4.6, line 1832; entireness and operator-norm evaluation are imported at §4.7, line 1936. The (Pr) case uses zero extension and compression, not the formal identity alone.

Import only the upstream criterion for a monic Q with unit constant coefficient, using its degree-correct reciprocal and the (Pr) zero-extension adapter. This is the case used by the slope construction. The inherited statement allows arbitrary monic Q; this entry does not establish that stronger generality.

Import finite coordinate detection for a finitely generated submodule of c0 under the upstream Noetherian Banach-Tate hypotheses. The inherited node states an algebraic result for a submodule of an arbitrary full product over any commutative Noetherian ring. That extra generality is not supplied by this locator and is not claimed by the import.

coverage.notes: Coverage records the existing authoritative upstream Layer 4 plan, not proof closure or equality with every stronger statement in the inherited packet. The import index distinguishes direct targets, supplier APIs, replaced proof routes, native library inputs, three qualified generalities and the excluded solid portion. No local mathematical targets are added; proposed ownership integration remains for the maintainer.

scopeExclusions.target: Solid-module localization and reconstruction, including the full solid f_*f^* comparison
scopeExclusions.reason: Issue #9294 explicitly excludes this formulation unless the atlas takes ownership of solid functional analysis. Upstream §4.17 also restricts its output to classical finite windows. Neither inversion nor a union of finite windows is a substitute for the solid theorem.
scopeExclusions.effect: Only its classical compact-operator part is imported; no claim is made about supplying or proving its solid part.

restructure.detail: The proposed L4 stage has acquired an upstream owner since the original packet was reviewed. Continuing its old blueprint round would duplicate the upstream roadmap.
restructure.proposal: Treat LocallyAnalyticDistributions:L4 as an import of TauCetiRoadmap/LocallyAnalyticDistributions Layer 4, using the immutable PR #854 reference in this packet. Preserve current stage IDs pending maintainer integration. No other layer or upstream document is changed.

boundaryAudit.auditUse: The reviewed audit does not establish that the analytic-family or p-adic Fredholm targets are already formalized. Its shared slope-summand overlap is handled by upstream importing RigidAnalyticGeometry §7.2, not by planning another supplier.
boundaryAudit.method: Read the authoritative open roadmap and its suggested file. Inspect current-main Suggested files for the nine roadmaps named in WORKERS and read the OperatorTheory boundary. Read native restricted-series, resultant-norm and compact-Riesz interfaces in the current library. These current-head checks are ownership checks, not replacements for baseline citations.
boundaryAudit.baselineUse: No mathematical declarations are added or cited as pinned baseline results. The suggested file checks only a native module import.

validation.mathematicalReview: No review or red-team verdict on upstream PR #854; source lineage is reported through that roadmap, without claiming a new reading of the underlying papers.

review.notes: Accepted as an ownership reconciliation under PROTOCOL §15 and the maintainer notice on #9294. Independently checked all 221 inherited IDs and the immutable target locators against the inherited statements and hypotheses; corrected six mappings or contract descriptions and recorded three limits on stronger inherited generalities. Verified source hashes, six obligation routes, the classical scope boundary and RT-AREA-iwasawa-2/5 disposition. There are no local mathematical nodes, baseline declarations, API items, unit tests or planets to certify. This acceptance does not review upstream PR #854 or its suppliers, verify their primary papers, assert proof closure, or replace maintainer integration of the proposed rescope.
